mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=1

SELECT m.message_id,m.sender_id,m.recipient_id,m.body,m.status,m.read_at,m.created_at, IF(m.sender_id=#{userId},m.recipient_id,m.sender_id) AS peer_id, u.nick_name AS peer_name,u.avatar AS peer_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_direct_message unread WHERE unread.sender_id=IF(m.sender_id=#{userId},m.recipient_id,m.sender_id) AND unread.recipient_id=#{userId} AND unread.status='SENT' AND unread.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count FROM zentide_direct_message m JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=IF(m.sender_id=#{userId},m.recipient_id,m.sender_id) WHERE (m.sender_id=#{userId} OR m.recipient_id=#{userId}) AND m.status='SENT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zentide_direct_message newer WHERE newer.status='SENT' AND ((newer.sender_id=#{userId} AND newer.recipient_id=IF(m.sender_id=#{userId},m.recipient_id,m.sender_id)) OR (newer.recipient_id=#{userId} AND newer.sender_id=IF(m.sender_id=#{userId},m.recipient_id,m.sender_id))) AND (newer.created_at>m.created_at OR (newer.created_at=m.created_at AND newer.message_id>m.message_id)) ) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.message_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.*,u.nick_name AS sender_name,u.avatar AS sender_avatar FROM zentide_direct_message m JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=m.sender_id WHERE m.status='SENT' AND ((m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.recipient_id=#{peerId}) OR (m.sender_id=#{peerId} AND m.recipient_id=#{userId})) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.message_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_direct_message SET read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE sender_id=#{peerId} AND recipient_id=#{userId} AND status='SENT' AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_direct_message WHERE recipient_id=#{userId} AND status='SENT' AND read_at IS NULL
